$comment: The permissions of the app's own commands that the frontend may be granted (AGENTS.md principle 6, #665).
Each one is allow-<command>, which tauri-build generates for a command of AppManifest::commands in src-tauri/build.rs.
The commands take document and request ids, never paths or URIs; each was reviewed with its card's PR.
Add an entry only together with the work card that needs it, a one-line reason, and the needs-security-review label.
scripts/ci/check-security-config.mjs checks this file. Core and plugin permissions are not listed here: they go into that script's ALLOWED_PLUGIN_PERMISSIONS.
